title: Probe exchange
summary: Swap a worn or wrong probe without damaging the new one or the head. Placeholder content written from general AFM practice, not from the manufacturer's manual.

steps.title: Raise the head fully
steps.body: Lift the Z stage to the top of its travel so the head has room to slide out.

steps.title: Unlock the head and slide it out
steps.body: Release the head lock, then slide the head straight toward you out of its mount. Rest it on the head stand with the probe facing up.
steps.caution: Support the head with both hands, and never set it down on its probe side.

steps.title: Remove the used probe
steps.body: Grip the chip carrier by its edges with tweezers and lift it off the mount. Put it in the used-probe box and note it in the logbook.

steps.title: Seat the new probe
steps.body: Pick up the new pre-mounted probe by the carrier edges and lower it onto the mount. It should settle into place on its own, with no force.
steps.caution: Never touch the cantilever end of the chip. If you drop a probe, treat it as broken.

steps.title: Slide the head back and lock it
steps.body: Slide the head back into the mount until it stops, then engage the lock.
steps.caution: An unlocked head drifts during a scan and can shift during approach.
steps.check: Head is fully seated and the lock is engaged

steps.title: Realign the beam
steps.body: Every probe sits slightly differently, so the old alignment no longer holds. Pick the scan procedure back up at the focus step.
